rows.grounds: compound specifying the nectar as the true nature of Kaula
compound qualifying the Kaula true nature as constituted by kāmakalā

items.question: What essential nature characterizes the Kaula nectar that is to be heard?
premises: The listener is commanded to hear.
The object to be heard is the nectar identified as the true nature of Kaula.
This Kaula nectar is characterized as consisting of the art of desire.
items.inference: The supreme Kaula nectar to be attended to is essentially constituted by the art of desire.
uncertainties: The precise doctrinal sense of kāmakalā in this context may admit multiple interpretations.
items.plain_english: Hear of the nectar, the true nature of Kaula, which consists of the art of desire.
